name: Solemn

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Assault
abilities.description: When standing further away from him, Solemn teleports and stabs the target, dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Brand
abilities.description: Charged melee attack dealing moderate-high physical damage then stunning and dealing low flame damage for 2 seconds (for 5 ticks in total). This can be blocked to negate the flame damage and to stagger Solemn instead.

abilities.name: Aperture
abilities.description: Solemn dashes three times in succession while rapidly throw daggers around, then he rapidly launches more daggers under a target for five seconds. All the daggers acts as traps which detonate when stepping on them, each dealing moderate-high physical damage. The daggers disappear after some time.

abilities.name: Blast Powder
abilities.description: Solemn throws powder at a target from range, which creates small lingering electric areas, each dealing continuous direct moderate shock damage.

abilities.name: Deadeye/Daggerstorm
abilities.description: Solemn launches fire all around him which creates many small flaming areas forming a large ring, dealing continuous direct moderate flame damage (Deadeye). After a very brief delay he bursts with fire, dealing moderate flame damage and knocking back in a large area around him (Daggerstorm).

abilities.name: Storm Atronach Summons [sic]
abilities.description: Solemn periodically becomes briefly invulnerable to summon four Gorne Wolves to assist him.

dialogue.speaker: Solemn
dialogue.trigger: When he does an AoE attack

When he does an AoE attack.speaker: Solemn
When he does an AoE attack.trigger: When he does an AoE attack

summary: Solemn is a Dark Seducer who can be found in the southeastern-most room, surrounded by wolves. He serves as one of the champions of the Gorne public dungeon.
